Advantages of overseas FX

•The margin required is 1/40 of a domestic account, so leftover money can go into stocks or spot crypto; even if you lose at FX in the worst case, you can just win with stocks or spot crypto
•You can hold multiple accounts, so you can split your money into a trading account and a fund-management account and trade with zero-cut at your back (no worry of losing big because a stop-loss slipped)
•No margin calls (追証)
•Spreads on the highly volatile GOLD are narrower than in domestic FX (scalping USD/JPY for 10 pips every day in domestic FX is hard)

Disadvantages of overseas FX

•Withdrawal refusals exist, so choosing a broker is extremely important (right now HFM and XS are the top two → which brokers are good changes depending on the environment)
•Because of the payment-agency (収納代行) problem, you need to deposit and withdraw using crypto

Conclusion→
Where FX ends up is scalping USD/JPY in domestic FX, but since the difficulty of winning is high, overseas FX GOLD is also one option.
Just pick whichever you like.
